purpose: Record of how the three families of analysis_plan_headroom.json were implemented and admitted, with the points where the implementation differs from the wording of the plan. Written after the gate and before any solver saw a question of the split.
differencesFromPlanWording: scopeOfEarlier: the plan names TSG RAN meetings 79 to 112; the exports hold CR packs of meetings 79 to 112 for RAN1 to RAN3, 77 to 112 for RAN4 and 78 to 112 for RAN5. The question says 'in the records', and no previous_pack gold row names meeting 77 or 78.

The pack-source check of the gate reads its document set for the three families from a separate table (CONSIDERED_THROUGH_CLAUSES), so that the table the stored reconciliation compares with the manuscript stays as it was; for clause_neighbours the anchor itself is left out because its pack is no part of the answer.
The same-CR-identity check of the gate applies to the seven earlier families only: the CR pack column of clause_neighbours holds the packs of the other change requests.

control_chain_gate.py is unchanged; its packed_sibling and false_empty controls are defined for the pack-column families and pack_lookup and produce no control for the three families. The six other kinds are applied (108 controls per item file, none admitted).
measure_relational_equivalence.py also runs the reference query with one condition removed or loosened (four controls); the plan did not ask for it.

The regression clause asks the claims verifiers to pass unchanged. After the families were added, the seven-family items regenerate byte for byte and reconcile_reported_counts.py passes 197 checks against a scratch output; the stored reconciliation is refreshed, and the verifiers rerun, after the manuscript edits of this cycle are complete.
